title: Village Defense
description: Collect gear chests, deploy hero skills, and upgrade tower defenses to protect your peaceful meadow village from relentless monster waves.
controls: Open starter chests to equip gear, tap Battle to start defending, and choose roguelite skill upgrades between monster waves.

zh-CN.title: 村庄保卫战
zh-CN.description: 轻肉鸽策略塔防：开局免费抽装备宝箱强化战力，排兵布阵并挑选局内技能流派，守卫村庄抵御怪物狂潮。
zh-CN.controls: 先领取装备宝箱并穿戴强化，点击开始游戏进入战斗，击杀怪物升级后三选一强化技能守住防线。
